_notes: Register: both consoles use dumneavoastră (polite plural imperatives in -ți). The Agency console's existing lines were in informal 'tu' (Folosește, numele tău, te-ai) and were converted; the University console addressed the office as 'voastră' (informal plural) and was changed to 'dumneavoastră'.

Agency tone: imperative, dense, who/what/by when. 'caseload' = 'portofoliul dumneavoastră'; 'pipeline' = 'studenți pe etape' / 'etapa în proces' (no CRM jargon); 'case' = 'dosar' (dosar de viză, etapa dosarului); 'service case' (concierge) = 'solicitare de servicii'; 'reply owed' = 'răspuns de dat'; 'waiting on X' = 'se așteaptă X'; SLA kept as SLA (operations staff).

University tone: formal, analytical. university review = 'evaluare' everywhere (was a mix of 'analiză' and 'evaluare'); document review/check = 'verificare'; essay review = 'evaluare'; student revision = 'revizuire'. 'Insights' = 'Statistici' (as the nav already says; v28.pipe.label pointed to a non-existent 'Analize'). Yield = 'Rata de înmatriculare', retention = 'Rata de retenție', offer rate = 'Rata ofertelor' (v25 said 'Rata de admitere').

Official names: 'scrisoare standard de admitere' in explanatory sentences (visa case opens on issuance); status/action labels keep the short 'scrisoare de admitere' like the English. 'Supralegalizare consulară', 'apostilă', 'legalizare notarială', 'verificare CHSI', 'viza D-2/D-4' kept. 'Notarization & legalization' = 'Legalizare notarială și apostilă/supralegalizare'. consultation = 'consultație' (was 'Consiliere' in one stage). dormitory = 'cămin'; housing = 'locuință'; plan = 'plan'.

Plurals: Romanian one/few/other; _few added for every family touched and _one where the family had none in the locale. Keys that carry {{count}} without a plural family (v27.evidence.ageDays, v27.stage.recent/stalled, v29.plan.term.supportDays, v25.chip.days) cannot receive new siblings (apply-patch creates only keys English has), so they were re-phrased as 'Label: {{count}}' to escape the 'N de zile' rule; v25.chip.days was left as it was.
Gendered names: 'al studentului {{name}}' / 'lui {{name}}' avoided where possible by rephrasing with a colon.

Apply with --allow-same: 14 lines are legitimately identical to English (Student ×4, Program ×3, Protocol, Original, GPA, Hangyul, Hangyul HQ, '{{count}} student', and the placeholder-only '{{student}} · {{doc}}: {{what}}'); the refusal rule cannot tell a Romanian word that happens to match English from an untranslated line. Dry run with --allow-same: 792 applied, 0 refused.
